summary.tldr: Creates provisional approval or registration paths for feeds, seeds and pest control products already approved in at least two trusted jurisdictions.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister to approve or register a feed on a provisional basis within 90 days if it is approved in at least two trusted jurisdictions and meets the Act and regulations.
Requires the Registrar to register a seed variety on a provisional basis within 90 days if it is approved for sale in at least two trusted jurisdictions and meets the prescribed requirements.
Allows an applicant to seek provisional registration of a pest control product if it is approved for use in at least two trusted jurisdictions, using review information from those jurisdictions.
Requires the Minister to register a pest control product on a provisional basis within 90 days if the product's health and environmental risks and value are not found to be unacceptable.
Lets the Minister and Registrar designate trusted jurisdictions by regulation and rely on evidence and information from those jurisdictions when evaluating applications.
summary.background: The bill adds “trusted jurisdiction” to each Act. It means a foreign state or part of a foreign state that is designated by regulation.
